LanguageData.ARIOIAF_HouseOfYourOwnGameStart:
You were born a bastard, with no lands, no inheritance, and little chance of ever carrying a name of your own.

Rather than spend your life beneath another House's banner, you left with your friends who chose to follow you. Together, you traveled beyond the settled lands with a few weapons, some supplies, and enough silver to begin again.

There is no castle waiting for you. No village. No title worth boasting of.

Only three companions, open land, and a banner for a House that does not yet exist.

Build your home, gather settlers, and make a name the realm will remember.

Not yet.
